name: work-tracker
description: Keeps your team's Work Tracker up to date with the status of the Jira ticket you're working on in Claude Code. Sends only who you are (git name/email), the ticket key, its Jira title/description, and the status changes and summaries Claude records. Jira itself is never changed.

server_url.title: Work Tracker address
server_url.description: The tracker's address, e.g. http://tracker.office.local:4000 (from the Connect page of the dashboard)

team_key.title: Team key
team_key.description: The team key shown on the dashboard's Connect page
